front: Khái niệm 'Verbs of liking + To-infinitive / Gerund' trong Unit 1: Leisure Time được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Verbs like like, love, hate, prefer can be followed by either a gerund (V-ing) or a to-infinitive (to V) with little difference in meaning.

💡 Ví dụ: I like making origami. / I like to make origami in my free time.
🌱 Bản chất: V-ing emphasizes the enjoyment of the activity; To-infinitive emphasizes habit, choice, or duty.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Verbs ONLY followed by Gerunds (V-ing)'?
back:
Certain verbs such as enjoy, fancy, adore, dislike, detest, mind can ONLY be followed by a gerund (V-ing), NEVER a to-infinitive.

📝 Ví dụ: She fancies doing DIY projects. (NOT: She fancies to do...)
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Memorizing the distinct verb categories prevents common grammatical errors.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Choose the correct form: 'My friends detest (surf) __________ the net when camping outdoors.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: Identify the main verb: 'detest' (meaning intensely dislike).
Step 2: 'Detest' belongs to the category of verbs followed strictly by a Gerund.
Step 3: Change 'surf' to 'surfing'.

👉 Kết luận: My friends detest surfing the net when camping outdoors.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Writing 'I enjoy to hang out with friends.'?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Writing 'I enjoy to hang out with friends.'

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: 'Enjoy' is always followed by a gerund: 'I enjoy hanging out with friends.'
